scope: Proposal only for bounded controlled-client approach coordination; no product implementation or runtime change is authorized by this file.

minimumBoundary.meaning: A tool-local hint that one live controlled client is already spending actual acknowledged approach steps on this target. It grants no world authority or economic ownership.
minimumBoundary.key: Actual mapFileName plus public target objectId; never infer a server incarnation.
minimumBoundary.owner: Controlled client identity/reference, never the nonunique owner objectId1000.
minimumBoundary.maximumEntries: At most the predeclared live combat actors, maximum10; at most one approach hint per client.
minimumBoundary.acquire: Synchronously immediately before a genuinely selected ordinary chase movement is sent; never while merely considering a candidate or replaying a read-only plan.
minimumBoundary.renew: Only a fresh successful ordinary UserLocation that proves progress in the existing chase segment; never mere plan selection, a timeout or a repeated non-improving receipt.
minimumBoundary.expiry: A small finite lease based on original native movement cadence, proposed three750ms opportunities. Expiry must not reset any existing chase ACK, loop, nonprogress or total-time budget.
minimumBoundary.release: Owned token only, on selected-target change, invalid or missing target, owner inactive/dead/map change, scout transition, original chase deferral, send failure or ordinary exit. A stale completion cannot release a newer owner's hint.
minimumBoundary.effect: An approaching rival considers other original eligible candidates or original scouting under the unchanged four-candidate/eight-neighbor/4000-node limits. Every original offered opportunity and failure remains in its denominator.

policyDecisionStillNeeded.adjacentReadyStrike: Prefer preserving an already adjacent, actually witnessed ordinary strike under the existing pending-attack targetClaims exclusion; an approach hint should not make a nearby productive strike wait behind a distant walker. Such a strike invalidates the old approach hint for the next decision, without cancelling an already sent move.
policyDecisionStillNeeded.scope: Implementing approach-only exclusion requires its own focused fixtures and root review. Do not simply add a global availableCombatTarget rejection that accidentally suppresses these already productive adjacent strikes.

requiredFocusedCasesBeforeProductChange: Two distinct clients sharing numeric owner objectId1000 cannot hold the same live approach hint.
A new token survives an old finally/release, and a lease cannot outlive the original finite chase budget.
No claim is created by an unsent candidate, failed path, read-only plan or ordinary scouting.
Unavailable shared target falls through to existing bounded alternatives without new A-star expansion or altered native cadence.
Existing valid adjacent witnessed attack, typed launch, dual-end damage,900ms evidence and pending targetClaims remain unchanged.
Fresh owner/map/target removal and diagnostic or command failure release only the appropriate tool-local hint.
limitations: This is not proof that reservation would satisfy the original sustained18launch/12positivehit requirements.
The failed third window contains substantial real scouting without a detected conservative overlapping approach span; local supply and stable-witness filter causes remain partly unobserved.
No proposed hint or peer observation may add ACK, hit, completion, movement or capacity credit.
